scene_sentence_zh: 海崖上的圓石塔只剩殘拱，霧中垂著一口青綠的鐘，腳下是一片空蕩的石台。

license.terms: Original artwork generated for this repository by its maintainers and committed with the project; it may be redistributed under the project's own repository terms. No third-party stock imagery, scraped artwork, or externally licensed asset is included.

production.method: sd-webui txt2img through the repository's internal client (world.art.sd_worker.SDWebUIClient.generate) using the shipped prompt library, then local WebP encoding through world.art.formats.encode
production.description: a ruined round stone bell tower rising from a sea cliff in thick fog, a green-bronze bell hanging in the broken arch at the top, wet slate and salt-stained masonry, cold diffuse sea light and wind-torn mist, a bare flagstone platform at the tower foot with open air beyond

visual_review.native_scale: Reviewed at native 1536x864: A painterly JRPG ruined round stone bell tower above the sea, a green-bronze bell hanging in the broken arch, sea spray and fog beyond, a bare flagstone platform at its foot and a small illegible plaque on one pier. No figure, no creature, no readable lettering; the tower and bell fill the upper two thirds over the open platform.
visual_review.desktop_cover_crop: Reviewed under the desktop 1451x790 cover crop: the full-bleed composition holds at 1451x790: the tower arch and bell keep the upper band, the platform and its dark piers frame an unobstructed lower foreground.
visual_review.contact_sheet: Reviewed on a ten-up contact sheet of the whole rite pack: each archetype reads as its own place — spring basin, stag statue, stone circle, sea tower, tree hollow, grave rows, crystal mine, sandstone arch, waterfall basin and capital plaza — with a consistent painterly palette and no two compositions alike.
